name: opinion-only
about: An abstract opinion. For a broad request, zero overlays is acceptable; a restrained visual metaphor that clarifies earned versus repeated advice is also acceptable. Do not categorically forbid opinion or metaphor, especially when explicitly requested.
transcript: I have been thinking about why some advice sticks and most of it does not. And I think it comes down to whether the person giving it has actually paid for the lesson. When someone tells you something they learned the hard way, you can hear it. There is a weight to it. When someone repeats something they read, it is lighter, and you can hear that too. So my filter now is simple. Before I take advice, I ask what it cost them. If the answer is nothing, I listen politely and move on.
